mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an easing monetary policy stance, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both rising) fails to predict positive 20-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), the signal (FEDFUNDS rise > 0.25pp) fails to predict negative 60-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 (index, base 2017=100) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a weakening demand environment, which reduces corporate revenue growth prospects and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (GDPC1 and HOUST both declining) fails to predict negative 60-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a strengthening manufacturing sector, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.
